title: Wireless Communication
subtitle: WiFi (ESP32), Bluetooth, and LoRa for IoT

content.text: The ESP32 has built-in WiFi and Bluetooth. It is ideal for IoT projects that need internet connectivity.

content.definition: Long Range radio: low data rate but can reach kilometres without infrastructure. Used for rural sensor networks.

content.text: Store WiFi credentials in NVS (non-volatile storage) or as build flags, not hardcoded in source.

questions.question: What microcontroller has built-in WiFi and is popular for IoT?
questions.explanation: The ESP32 from Espressif has dual-core CPU, WiFi, Bluetooth, and runs at 240 MHz — ideal for IoT.

faq.q: What is the range of Bluetooth LE?
faq.a: Typically 10-100 metres depending on obstacles and antenna. Good for local device communication.

examples: ESP32 temperature sensor posting data to a REST API every minute
